parsed.post: Kept DEPTH 8: 0.8522 -> 0.8366. Increasing capacity from 6 to 8 layers continues to drive down val_bpb, even with the current batch size. Next, I'll test increasing DEPTH to 10 to see if scaling continues to pay off or if the 5-minute budget limits optimizer steps too much.
